title: Building
description: A type of building, including houses, roads and bridges. A multi-stage monument or wonder is a building plus a monument file that names it. Buildings never name their own unlock: a tech, civic or monument lists them in its effects, or the building sets start. One file per building in content/buildings/<id>.json.

category.description: What the building is for. Systems branch on this, and modifiers can target it.

footprint.description: Width and height in tiles before rotation.

placement.description: Where the building may stand and what it needs nearby. Leave out for any buildable terrain with road access.

terrain.description: The terrains it may stand on; empty or absent means any buildable terrain.

roadAccess.description: Whether it needs a road beside it to work; true when absent.

coastline.description: Whether it must stand on the coast.

riverside.description: Whether it must stand beside a river.

deposit.description: The deposit it must stand over.

fertility.description: Enough of the footprint must be fertile for a crop.

minPercent.description: The least share of footprint tiles that must be fertile.

areaYield.description: How a gatherer's yield is measured from the map around it. A footprint_fertility yield needs placement.fertility, and a footprint_deposit yield needs placement.deposit.

terrain.description: For kind radius: the terrains that count.

radius.description: For kind radius: the search radius in tiles.

fullAt.description: For kind radius: the number of counted tiles that gives a full yield.

exclusive.description: For kind radius: whether tiles already claimed by a lower-ID building are skipped.

cost.description: What the building costs to build; free when absent. The reserved key coin is coin.

buildDays.description: Build time in days; 0 for roads and pre-placed buildings.

workforce.description: The workers it needs, all of one tier.

recipe.description: The recipe it runs, if it is a producer. A recipe a building names is available with that building.

storage.description: Storehouse behaviour: it stores goods in the island pool and sends carts.

reach.description: How far its carts reach, in road-distance tiles.

service.description: A service the building provides within road range.

coverage.description: The coverage radius, in road-distance tiles.

outputs.description: Knowledge, culture, coin and creativity it produces per day.

slots.description: Great-work display slots it offers. The type is a great-work type ID, or any for slots that take any type. Each type is listed once.

upgradeOf.description: The building this one upgrades in place.

fuel.description: Fuel the building burns each day.

upkeepCoin.description: Coin upkeep per day (Era II onward only).

attractiveness.description: Attractiveness it adds; negative for heavy industry.

roadCost.description: For road types, the travel cost per tile in thousandths (dirt road 1000).

bridgeSpan.description: For bridge road types, the longest river span in tiles. A bridge also needs roadCost.

siteBonus.description: Bonuses that apply to this building only, depending on where it stands.

aura.description: A modifier the building spreads over the buildings or residents within its road coverage. The target is required and never island-wide.

unique.description: Whether only one may exist per island.

start.description: Whether the building is available from the start. Otherwise exactly one tech, civic or monument unlocks it.
